qualification_and_assurance_precedents.system: Ferrocene (ISO 26262 TCL3 / ASIL D, IEC 61508 T3 / SIL 4, IEC 62304 Class C)
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.supported_subset_and_deviations: Full stable Rust 2021/2024 as specified by FLS (4,014 `:dp:` paragraph IDs across 29 chapters in `rust-lang/fls` @ `946eacae`); procedural macros, inline assembly, and unvalidated `-C`/`-Z` flags require end-user safety justification under the Safety Manual.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.known_problems_mechanism: Publicly versioned Known Problems Register mapping upstream `rust-lang/rust` `I-unsound` / `I-miscompile` issues to affected CLI flags, language constructs, and mandatory user workarounds.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.traceability_and_assurance_artifact: Bidirectional traceability matrix linking each of the 4,014 FLS paragraph IDs (`fls_<alphanumeric>`) to upstream `tests/ui/` test files via structured annotations.

qualification_and_assurance_precedents.system: CompCert 3.18 & Qualification Kit (DO-178C / DO-330 TQL-1, ISO 26262 ASIL D, IEC 61508 SIL 3)
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.supported_subset_and_deviations: CompCert C subset of ISO C99/C11: omits `setjmp`/`longjmp`, variable-length arrays (VLAs), non-structured `switch` (Duff's device), and `complex` numbers. Explicitly documents semantic deviations from ISO C (e.g., signed integer overflow is defined modular 2^N in RTL but UB in C; bitfield layout and evaluation-order constraints).
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.known_problems_mechanism: Trust-Boundary Split Table separating Coq-verified passes (`Clight` -> `Asm`) from unverified OCaml passes (`cparser`, `C2C` elaboration, register allocation heuristics prior to `Allocation.v` IRC check, `Asmexpand`, assembler/linker).
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.traceability_and_assurance_artifact: Valex qualification kit + Tool Accomplishment Summary (TAS) + Tool Operational Requirements (TOR) + Coq `Print Assumptions` check confirming reliance only on standard Coq axioms.

qualification_and_assurance_precedents.supported_subset_and_deviations: C99 subset (`Crest` / `AutoCorres` C-to-Isabelle parser) + explicit assembly stubs.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.known_problems_mechanism: Explicit top-level Assumption Ledger categorizing unverified hardware/boot/DMA/MMU/TLB hypotheses required for the end-to-end refinement theorem to hold.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.traceability_and_assurance_artifact: Isabelle/HOL refinement stack (`Abstract` -> `Executable` -> `C` -> `Binary` via `graph-refine`) + GSN (Goal Structuring Notation) assurance case for military/aviation deployments.

qualification_and_assurance_precedents.supported_subset_and_deviations: Pure/stateful ML subset with explicit FFI byte-array oracle calls (`call_FFI`).
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.known_problems_mechanism: End-to-end HOL4 theorem `compile_correct` packs all external assumptions as explicit syntactic antecedent predicates (`machine_ok`, `ffi_convention`, `enough_space`, `code_in_memory`).
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.traceability_and_assurance_artifact: Single top-level HOL4 theorem relating source operational semantics to target machine-code semantics up to explicit out-of-memory (`Resource_limit_hit`) or FFI divergence.

qualification_and_assurance_precedents.supported_subset_and_deviations: `cg_clif` (`compiler/rustc_codegen_cranelift/Readme.md`) and `cg_gcc` (`compiler/rustc_codegen_gcc/Readme.md`) maintain explicit feature-gap checklists (e.g., unwinding on Windows, exotic SIMD intrinsics, `#[naked]` functions, linker plugin LTO). `gccrs` tracks milestone tables against FLS and upstream `tests/ui/`. `mrustc` documents omitted borrow checking and panic=abort bootstrap constraints.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.known_problems_mechanism: Per-target CI exclusion lists (`config.toml` / `tests/ui` ignore headers) + explicit hard errors (never silent miscompilation) when encountering an unsupported intrinsic or ABI.
qualification_and_assurance_precedents.traceability_and_assurance_artifact: Pass/skip diffs against upstream `rustc` `tests/ui`, `tests/run-make`, and `cargo test`.
